governance_note: Document coefficient construction, sector orientation, imports, and fixed-coefficient assumptions.
Check I minus A for invertibility, conditioning, and numerical stability.
Report spectral radius, feasibility, and nonnegative output checks.
Export total requirements, direct and indirect dependence, and multiplier structure.
Define final demand shock and interpret under fixed-coefficient assumptions.
Document environmental or social extension coefficients, units, allocation, and provenance.
Test coefficient perturbations, demand uncertainty, aggregation, and boundary choices.
Present Leontief results as structured estimates, not automatic causal proof or complete forecasts.
